caption: Supplementary Figure S3 | Historical station-grouped sensitivity. Panels (A,B) compare strict/sensitivity AOD quality screening and HGB/Ridge estimators under log-smear prediction. Panels (C,D) compare strict-HGB target/retransformation branches. Left-hand panels use models without meteorology, and right-hand panels use models with meteorology. Cell labels give R²; colors use a symmetric logarithmic scale. Negative estimates are retained, and Portugal is labeled PT. AOD denotes aerosol optical depth; HGB denotes histogram-based gradient boosting. QA denotes quality assurance; sens. denotes the sensitivity AOD screening rule.
